verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Hoppscotch can *import* OpenAPI specs (tags-as-folders import) and that the documentation site itself has no machine-readable OpenAPI/openapi.json endpoint (404 on all probed paths). There is no evidence of a feature to export/download a Hoppscotch collection as an OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file, which is what an AI-native user would need. Missing for 10: documented export-to-OpenAPI feature, generated spec download link, or CLI/API command producing a machine-readable spec.
